In this section from *web books thingsastheyare section0010 html 69d60d*, the master explains: *"The mind was impetuous and spoke right up without any fear."*. From the perspective of the Four Noble Truths, suffering arises whenever the mind grasps at impermanent phenomena (*anicca*) as a reliable self (*atta*).
